summary: Re-tested FIX A (full-chain back navigation) on Populus Expo web at http://localhost:3000, mobile viewport 390x844. All three tests PASS: (A) full-chain back — 4 navigation hops (profile→/circle/me→/user/D→/circle/D→/user/B) followed by 4 back presses correctly walk back one screen at a time and the CRITICAL 4th back from /circle/{me} now lands on /profile (previously collapsed to '/'). Verified URLs at every step: back1 /user/B→/circle/D PASS, back2 /circle/D→/user/D PASS, back3 /user/D→/circle/me PASS, back4 /circle/me→/profile PASS. (B) user-circle-toggle useFocusEffect label refresh — label flips AGGIUNGI→NELLA CERCHIA after add, and back to AGGIUNGI after removing via /circle/me and re-entering /user/C. (C) circle-remove-confirm-modal — modal shows 'Rimuovi dalla cerchia' / 'Rimuovere @nickname dalla tua cerchia?' with ANNULLA + RIMUOVI buttons; ANNULLA dismisses modal and preserves membership; RIMUOVI removes. Fix in /app/frontend/src/utils/useSmartBack.ts (Platform.OS==='web' branch now prefers caller-supplied fallback over router.back()) works exactly as intended. No regressions on B or C.
critical_code_review_comments: useSmartBack.ts fix is minimal and correct: on web, when navStack is empty AND no `from` query is present, the caller-supplied fallback is now honoured before falling through to router.back() (which on Expo web collapses to '/'). Native behaviour (router.canGoBack + router.back) is preserved. The manual navStack still walks the full chain step-by-step via router.replace for backs 1→3, and the fallback only fires when the stack is fully drained — exactly the intended semantics.

rca_of_issue: Previous bug (iter 51): after walking the full navStack chain via router.replace (which drops the '?from=/profile' query), the final goBack on /circle/{me} hit `router.canGoBack()===true` on Expo web, invoked `router.back()`, and browser history collapsed to '/'. Fix (iter 52): reorder the fallback chain in useSmartBack — on Platform.OS==='web', when navStack.popAndPeek() returns nothing AND `from` is empty, use caller-supplied `fallback` immediately, BEFORE testing router.canGoBack(). This ensures the developer's tab-owner hint (`/profile` for /circle/{me} when userId===self) always wins on web. Confirmed by playwright: URL correctly transitions /circle/user_2a0ff12bc193 → /profile after 4th back.
